name: The Straight Run
tagline: Program your robot's very first movement rule.
narrative:
Welcome to Algorithm Engine!

A robot stands at the entrance of a straight corridor, facing toward the exit. Although it has motors to step forward and wait, its brain has zero rules—so it just stands still.

Your task is to teach it two basic decisions: move forward when the path ahead is clear, and stop once it reaches the exit goal.
objective: Reach the corridor exit and remain on it for 3 consecutive ticks.
learningObjective: Understand how rules link a condition (WHEN) to an action (DO), and how rules are evaluated top-to-bottom.
intelligenceExplanation:
The robot relies on you to make decisions. Every tick, the engine reads sensory inputs, finds the first matching rule, and performs its action.

To complete this level, add a rule to step forward when the path is clear, and place a rule to hold at the top so it stops upon reaching the exit.
hint: Add two rules: WHEN atGoal -> DO hold, and WHEN !wallAhead -> DO step.
hints: The robot will not move until you add a rule.
Add a rule: WHEN !wallAhead -> DO step to make it walk forward.
Place WHEN atGoal -> DO hold at the top of the rules list so it settles on arrival.
brief: Guide the robot to the exit tile and stay there for 3 ticks.
context: The corridor is straight, but the robot has no rules and doesn't know what to do.

steps.label: Add a movement rule for a clear path
Reach the exit and stay on it for 3 ticks

goals.description: Reach the exit of the corridor.

objectives.label: Reach the exit and settle on it
